//: THE MINOR HOUSES OF THE REACH (GDD §19 'smaller houses that control smaller things, or nothing at all'). Merged into every scenario played on the_reach: a house, its people, its planet or station appear wherever the scenario has not placed its own. Scenario definitions always win on an id or a system. Two houses are landless by design. The Golden Concourse, the Lantern Shoals, the Ashen Verge and the Pale Reaches each bring their own houses; the Gallows and Sorrow are held by no one.

fleets.//: The OFFICE fleet (GDD §8): the chair pays for it and fuels it; the Admiral of the Reach commands it; a commission moves it.
